summary: BYD launches the third-generation Tang with steer-by-wire digital chassis, while Galaxy M8, Stelato V8 and Jetour Huanyouzhe EV arrive in quick succession, kicking off a full-blown year-end new car battle.

articles.title: BYD's Third-Generation Tang Goes on Sale: X-by-Wire Digital Chassis Debuts, Starting at 187,900 Yuan
articles.summary: BYD's third-generation Tang has officially launched, starting at 187,900 yuan, making it a flagship model featuring X-by-wire digital chassis technology.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, BYD's third-generation Tang has officially gone on sale with a starting price of 187,900 yuan. The new vehicle's biggest highlight is its in-house developed X-by-wire digital chassis technology — an architecture previously seen mostly in high-end luxury brands and concept cars, now brought by BYD into the mainstream SUV price range. The X-by-wire digital chassis replaces traditional mechanical linkages with electrical signals, enabling precise electronic control of steering, braking, and suspension actuators, and opening up greater potential for chassis response speed, intelligent driving control accuracy, and over-the-air update capabilities. Paired with BYD's mature battery-motor-electronics ecosystem, the third-generation Tang delivers simultaneous leaps in driving performance and smart features. BYD's decision to roll out new models in rapid succession at year-end aims to further consolidate its share advantage in the 200,000-300,000 yuan mainstream new energy SUV market.
articles.impact: The migration of X-by-wire digital chassis technology from the premium segment down to the 200,000-yuan level will drive a generational upgrade in mainstream SUV driving dynamics and intelligent driving capabilities, accelerating the technological obsolescence of traditional mechanical chassis systems.

articles.title: Geely Galaxy M8 Opens Pre-Sales: From 199,800 Yuan, Standard 53kWh Battery and Five-Seat Layout
articles.summary: The Geely Galaxy M8 starts pre-sales at 199,800 yuan, offering a standard 3-kWh large battery and a spacious five-seat layout, targeting the mid-to-large NEV family vehicle market.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, Geely has officially opened pre-sales for the Galaxy M8, a new mid-to-large SUV in the Galaxy series, with prices starting at 199,800 yuan. The vehicle's product strengths center on two key selling points: first, a 53kWh battery pack fitted as standard across the lineup, which stands out at this pre-sale price point and directly addresses consumers' core concerns about pure-electric range and running costs; second, a five-seat layout that forgoes the common seven-seat configuration, concentrating cabin space on rear-seat comfort and cargo capacity to precisely target urban family use scenarios. The Galaxy M8 further strengthens Geely Galaxy's product portfolio in the mid-to-high-end NEV market, forming coordinated price and positioning coverage alongside other models in the series.
articles.impact: A standard 3kWh battery combined with a five-seat positioning creates direct competitive pressure on plug-in hybrid SUVs at the same price, potentially reshaping the configuration benchmark for family SUVs in the 200,000-yuan segment.

articles.title: AITO V8 Officially Launched: From 319,800 Yuan, Targeting the Fully Loaded 350,000-Yuan MPV Segment
articles.summary: The AITO V8 launches at 319,800 yuan, taking a fully loaded approach to compete in the premium 350,000-yuan MPV segment.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, AITO has officially launched its MPV model, the V8, priced from 319,800 yuan. The company positions it as the "fully loaded answer for 350,000-yuan MPVs," meaning the vehicle adopts a high-spec strategy across all trims, seeking to win premium MPV buyers through configuration density rather than low pricing alone. The 350,000-yuan MPV segment has long been dominated by joint-venture brands, but in recent months several domestic brands and new-energy players have entered with smart and electrified offerings. Backed by Huawei's intelligent ecosystem, the AITO V8 is expected to create differentiated selling points in cabin experience and smart driving, becoming a new variable in this niche market.
articles.impact: Competition in the premium MPV segment is shifting from joint-venture dominance to a full-scale battle among smart domestic newcomers, significantly expanding consumer choices in the 350,000-yuan budget range.

articles.title: Jetour Wanderer EV Launched: From 89,900 Yuan, a Boxy Light-Off-Road Electric SUV
articles.summary: The Jetour Wanderer EV launches at 89,900 yuan, combining an urban light-off-road boxy design with pure-electric mobility.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, the Jetour Wanderer EV has officially launched, priced from 89,900 yuan. Positioned as an "urban light-off-road boxy SUV," the vehicle pairs the signature boxy styling of rugged SUVs with a pure-electric powertrain, targeting combined scenarios of city commuting and weekend getaways. Its 89,900-yuan starting price makes it one of the most affordable boxy-style electric SUVs currently on the market. Boxy designs have gained steady popularity among younger Chinese consumers over the past two years, but mainstream products are generally priced higher; the Wanderer EV enters as an affordable electric option, poised to capture demand for distinctive-looking SUVs in lower-tier markets.
articles.impact: Boxy styling breaking below the 90,000-yuan mark could unlock demand for personalized electric SUVs in lower-tier markets and reshape the competitive landscape of entry-level NEV SUVs.

articles.title: Mercedes-Benz Recalls Nearly 180,000 Vehicles in China in Rare-Scale Action
articles.summary: Mercedes-Benz has launched another recall in the Chinese market, affecting nearly 180,000 vehicles in a relatively large-scale action.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, Mercedes-Benz has launched another vehicle recall in the Chinese market, this time covering nearly 180,000 units — a scale rarely seen in recent luxury-brand recall events. As one of the luxury automakers with the largest sales volume in China, the large-scale recall will directly affect the repair and service scheduling of a significant number of existing owners. In recent years, the State Administration for Market Regulation has continued to tighten oversight of auto recalls, and recalls involving luxury brands due to electronic and electrical architecture, driver-assistance systems, and powertrain issues have become increasingly routine. The specific recall reasons and affected models are subject to official recall announcements.
articles.impact: A recall of nearly 180,000 vehicles will disrupt service arrangements for a large number of owners, while reminding consumers to watch for recall and software update notices on their luxury-brand vehicles.

articles.title: AUDI Marks Two Years in China as New-Energy Push Enters Next Phase
articles.summary: AUDI celebrates its second anniversary in China, saying its new-energy business has entered a new stage of development.
articles.detail: NetEase Auto reports that the AUDI brand has officially marked two years of development in the Chinese market and outlined the next phase of its new-energy strategy. As a key vehicle for an international luxury brand's electrification drive in China, AUDI has invested steadily over the past two years in product launches, localized R&D and channel development. The company said the next chapter of its new-energy journey has begun, signaling a shift from early market groundwork to a phase more focused on scale and customer operations. Amid growing pressure from premium domestic brands and new-energy upstarts, how international luxury players respond to Chinese consumer needs through localized products and services has become the central challenge for AUDI's next stage.
articles.impact: The new-energy competition among international luxury brands in China is entering deeper waters, with localized R&D and service systems set to become key variables determining market share.

articles.title: Huawei's New Large Foldable Offers More for Less, Spotlighting Smart-Cockpit Ecosystem Expansion
articles.summary: Huawei's new large foldable phone, billed as offering more for less, draws joint attention from the tech and auto sectors, with ecosystem synergy in focus.
articles.detail: Baidu Hot Search shows Huawei's new large foldable has become a talking point with its more-for-less strategy. Although the star product is a consumer electronics device, its impact on the automotive industry should not be underestimated: Huawei's phones, tablets, in-car systems and smart cockpit ecosystem have long worked in tandem, and capabilities such as large screens, multi-screen transitions and cross-device connectivity directly affect the user experience of HarmonyOS cockpits and partner models from AITO, Stelato and Luxeed. The device-side upgrade strategy reflects Huawei's continued iteration in hardware computing power, displays and system capabilities, which will further feed back into its in-car ecosystem. For car users, the most direct benefit will be a smoother phone-to-vehicle seamless transfer experience.
articles.impact: Upgrades to Huawei's device capabilities will continue to enhance smart cockpit experiences, reinforcing the cross-device connectivity advantage of HarmonyOS-based models.

articles.title: Nvidia Share Swings Rattle Sentiment in Auto AI Computing Supply Chain
articles.summary: China's Foreign Ministry responds to Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia; Nasdaq opens down 1.5%, Nvidia falls over 3%, drawing attention to the auto AI computing sector.
articles.detail: Baidu Hot Search reports that China's Foreign Ministry responded to news of Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia, while the same day U.S. equities opened with the Nasdaq down 1.5% and Nvidia shares falling more than 3%. Nvidia is one of the world's leading chip suppliers for intelligent driving and smart cockpit computing, with its Orin and Thor in-vehicle computing platforms adopted by numerous Chinese and global automakers. The company's business and personnel moves are often seen as a bellwether for the smart driving supply chain. This share volatility, combined with executive-level personnel headlines, may affect capital market sentiment toward the intelligent driving computing segment in the short term, but is unlikely to have a meaningful impact on actual chip deliveries and product planning at automakers.
articles.impact: Nvidia's swings may briefly unsettle sentiment in the intelligent driving computing segment, but in the long run automakers' multi-supplier strategies will reduce dependence on any single chip vendor.

articles.title: 25 Years of China's NEV Industry: A Leap Toward High-Quality Growth
articles.summary: Xinhua In-Depth reviews 25 years of China's new energy vehicle industry, noting high-quality development has become the sector's defining theme.
articles.detail: According to a Xinhua In-Depth report republished by Sogou News, China's new energy vehicle industry has completed a 25-year journey, transitioning from policy-driven to market-driven growth and moving from catching up to matching — and now leading — global peers. The report notes the industry has built a complete supply chain across core areas such as batteries, motors and electronic controls, with production and sales ranking first worldwide for consecutive years, while gaining new competitive advantages in intelligent and connected technologies. The sector has now entered a new stage of high-quality development, shifting focus from scale expansion to technological breakthroughs, brand upgrading and global expansion. At the same time, the industry faces new challenges including margin pressure under intense competition and changes in overseas trade environments.
articles.impact: As the industry shifts from scale expansion to high-quality competition, technological depth and global capabilities will become the key dividing line shaping the next phase of differentiation.

articles.title: Academician Ouyang Minggao: Dual Drivers of Intelligence and Low Carbon Accelerate NEV Industry Upgrade
articles.summary: Academician Ouyang Minggao says intelligence and low-carbon development will push the NEV industry into a new phase of accelerated upgrade.
articles.detail: According to a report republished by Sogou News, Chinese Academy of Sciences Academician Ouyang Minggao assessed the development direction of the new energy vehicle industry, saying the sector is embarking on a new journey of intelligent and low-carbon growth and is on an accelerated upgrade trajectory. On the intelligence front, advanced driver assistance, smart cockpits and vehicle-road-cloud integration are the main lines of technological evolution; on the low-carbon front, power battery recycling, use of green electricity and full-lifecycle carbon emission management are growing in importance. Ouyang also stressed that full competition is a vital force shaping the strengths of China's NEV sector — it is market competition that has driven rapid technology iteration and sustained cost reduction, creating the global competitiveness of China's auto industry today.
articles.impact: The dual focus on intelligence and low carbon is clearly defined, guiding automakers to concentrate R&D resources while shifting investment logic across the supply chain.

articles.title: Guangzhou Auto Show Nears: 2027 Voyah Taishan to Open Pre-Sales as Flagship Electric Six-Seat SUV
articles.summary: The 2027 Voyah Taishan will open pre-sales at the Guangzhou Auto Show, positioned as a flagship all-electric large six-seat SUV.
articles.detail: NetEase Auto reports that the 2027 Voyah Taishan will confirm its pre-sales launch during the Guangzhou Auto Show, with the new model positioned as a flagship all-electric large six-seat SUV. With the show drawing near, automakers are releasing new models at a rapid pace. Voyah is entering the high-end electric large six-seat segment under its flagship banner, where it will compete head-on with Li Auto, Aito, Stelato and others. Large six-seat electric SUVs are currently one of the core choices for premium family buyers, and Voyah's early push under the 2027 model year signals its intent to gain an edge in next year's market. More new-model information is expected before and after the show.
articles.impact: The Guangzhou Auto Show will become the year-end window for a concentrated wave of new-model launches, and competition in the high-end large six-seat electric SUV segment will intensify further.

articles.title: Changan Declares 'No Tiered Safety by Trim Level' as Tech Accessibility Becomes New Battleground for Automakers
articles.summary: A Changan Auto executive said safety technology should not be segmented by trim level, calling for universal access to safety features.
articles.detail: In an interview with NetEase Auto, Changan Auto executive Jiang Ping explicitly put forward the principle of "no tiered safety by trim level," saying Changan will make safety technology widely accessible — core safety features should not be limited to top trims but rolled out across the full lineup. NetEase Auto also released real-world fuel-consumption test data for the Changan CS75 PLUS Blue Whale Super Engine, recording just 3.6L per 100 kilometers, demonstrating the Blue Whale powertrain's technical depth in fuel economy. With new energy and intelligent features dominating the agenda, fundamentals such as safety and energy consumption are regaining importance as key competitive dimensions for automakers.
articles.impact: If universal safety features across the lineup become an industry norm, safety standards for mid- and lower-trim models will rise overall, delivering clear benefits to consumers.
